import sys


def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read()
    config, queries_part = text.partition("===\n")
    config = config.strip()
    queries = queries_part.strip().splitlines() if queries_part else []

    data = {}
    current_section = ""

    for line in config.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith(";"):
            continue
        if line.startswith("["):
            current_section = line[1:-1]
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        key = key.strip()
        value = value.strip()
        if current_section:
            data.setdefault(current_section, {})[key] = value
        else:
            data.setdefault("", {})[key] = value

    for query in queries:
        if not query.strip():
            continue
        section, key = query.split(".")
        section = section.lower()
        key = key.lower()
        print(data.get(section, {}).get(key, "NOT FOUND"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
